messages:
Alex R: Heads-up — planning a quiet cutover for nova-13b-v3 in the model catalog tonight during the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. Canary = 5% traffic, EU-only. Primary objective: collect latency/cost deltas + safety telemetry.

Samir K: +1. What's the fallback ordering if we see regressions?

Alex R: Fallback ordering we want enforced: nova-13b-v2 -> quant-nova-13b -> open-13b-backup. Will pin nova-13b-v2 at 100% for rollback hold.

Jen L: Add explicit rollback thresholds please. My proposal: p50 latency increase > 120ms over baseline OR error rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m => automatic rollback to pinned variant. Also manual abort if devex sees hallucination spike in eval set.

Alex R: Agreed. I'll codify those as canary gates.

deploy-bot: Canary build scheduled: enable model catalog entry 'nova-13b-v3' at 2025-10-09T02:00:00Z | mode: canary | traffic: 5% | regions: eu-west-1 | fallback: pinned=nova-13b-v2.

Maria P: I pushed the rollout config to staging. Quick snippet for ops team:
```yaml
catalog_enable:  true
model: nova-13b-v3
canary:
  pct: 5
  regions: [eu-west-1]
fallback_order: [nova-13b-v2, quant-nova-13b, open-13b-backup]
rollback_thresholds:
  latency_p50_delta_ms: 120
  error_rate_pct: 0.5
  sustained_minutes: 3
```

Samir K: Nice. Ops checklist: confirm canary traffic shaping, ensure KV cache flush is disabled during the 1st minute of the canary to avoid warm miss skew, and ensure routing weight ramp up uses linear schedule.

Alex R: Deploybot will perform staged ramp: 5% -> 25% (02:20) -> 50% (02:40) -> full at EOD only if gates pass. If any gate trips, rollback to pinned variant immediately and notify channel.

deploy-bot: Observability hooks configured: telemetry sinks -> redwood-console/canary-nova13b, alert channels -> #eng-releases and @ops-oncall. Canary dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/canary/nova-13b-v3

Jen L: Quick ask — please capture token-level cost delta in the canary. If cost/token > 1.08x baseline AND latency not improved, we should auto-halt and flag for cost review.

Maria P: Added cost delta threshold: 1.08. Updated config saved.

ops-oncall: I'll be watching the telemetry window at 02:00-03:00 UTC. @Alex R @Samir K, if we see p95 > 600ms for > 2m during the ramp, I'll trigger manual rollback.

Alex R: Thanks — call flow for rollback:
1) ops-oncall posts "rollback now" in this thread -> deploy-bot runs rollback job.
2) deploy-bot posts job id + status.
3) team runs postmortem template and pins decision in release notes.

Samir K: One more: ensure the catalog index update does not evict pinned models from hot routing. We want pinned fallback to be immediately reachable.

Maria P: Confirmed. Pinning sets a low-latency route. Also pre-warmed a few replicas of nova-13b-v2 for immediate failover.

Jen L: If rollback happens, let's also snapshot the last 10k requests to a temporary S3 bucket for offline regression tests.

Alex R: Good call. deploy-bot — add snapshot step to rollback playbook.

deploy-bot: Rollback playbook updated: snapshot_last_requests=true | sample_size=10000 | s3_path=s3://redwood-canary-dumps/nova13b-v3/1759991111/

Maria P: I'll add a short line to the release notes after cutover with the canary thresholds and the fallback ladder.

Alex R: Ok team — ready for the 02:00 UTC change window. Please be on standby 01:50-03:10 UTC. :thumbsup:

Samir K: I'll be there.

ops-oncall: Oncall ready. Will escalate to infra if we see degraded GPU health during ramp.

Jen L: Good luck. Hoping for clean metrics. :crossed_fingers:

deploy-bot: Canary executed at 2025-10-09T02:00:00Z. Monitoring active.

Alex R: (final) If anyone sees anything odd, post short note here and tag @ops-oncall. We'll keep the pinned fallback in place until we convene a post-rollout review.
